final: SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS fielding_record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fielding f2 JOIN player p2 ON p2.player_id = f2.player_id) AS share_of_total, COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p3.bats) FROM fielding f3 JOIN player p3 ON p3.player_id = f3.player_id) AS above_average FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p4.bats) FROM fielding f4 JOIN player p4 ON p4.player_id = f4.player_id)
